```lean4
theorem p06_pow_mod : 7 ^ 2026 % 100 = p06_answer := by

  -- Now we need to show 7^20 ≡ 1 (mod 100) and then compute 7^6 mod 100
  norm_num [Nat.pow_mod, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.add_mod]

```
